title: Reception of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message by the L2 U2N Relay UE

entities.name: RemoteUEInformationSidelink message
entities.description: Message received by L2 U2N Relay UE containing remote UE information elements.

entities.name: sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE
entities.description: Information element indicating paging configuration for remote UE, with setup or release values.

entities.name: sl-Requested-SI-List
entities.description: Information element containing requested system information list for remote UE.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not actively connected but can be paged.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is inactive but maintains some connection context.

entities.name: Paging message monitoring
entities.description: Procedure where UE monitors paging occasions for incoming paging messages.

entities.name: SidelinkUEInformationNR transmission
entities.description: Procedure for transmitting sidelink UE information to the network.

entities.name: System information acquisition
entities.description: Procedure for acquiring system information blocks as requested.

entities.name: sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE set to setup
entities.description: Condition where sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE IE indicates setup operation.

entities.name: sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE set to release
entities.description: Condition where sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE IE indicates release operation.

entities.name: sl-Requested-SI-List set to setup
entities.description: Condition where sl-Requested-SI-List IE indicates setup operation.

entities.name: sl-Requested-SI-List set to release
entities.description: Condition where sl-Requested-SI-List IE indicates release operation.

entities.name: pagingSearchSpace configured
entities.description: Condition where active BWP has common search space with pagingSearchSpace configured.

relations.description: sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE IE guards behavior based on setup condition.
sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE IE guards behavior based on release condition.
sl-Requested-SI-List IE guards behavior based on setup condition.
sl-Requested-SI-List IE guards behavior based on release condition.
sl-PagingInfo setup condition establishes paging message monitoring procedure.
sl-PagingInfo release condition stops paging message monitoring.
sl-Requested-SI-List setup condition establishes system information acquisition procedure.
sl-Requested-SI-List release condition stops system information acquisition.
Paging message monitoring requires RRC_CONNECTED state with pagingSearchSpace configured.
Paging message monitoring requires RRC_IDLE state.
Paging message monitoring requires RRC_INACTIVE state.
SidelinkUEInformationNR transmission requires RRC_CONNECTED state without pagingSearchSpace.
